findings.message: 1 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "What changed for them." → 3 lines (4 words, 46px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.
Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 7 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "BCG offer", "Pending approval", "Bain offer", "Pending approval").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: 2 gradient fill(s): div.hero-tint → linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(10, 35, 42, 0.72) 0%, rgba(10, 38, 44, 0.64) 37%, rgba(10, 38, 44, 0.26) 67%, rgba | section#starting-point.starting-section → linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(8, 33, 41, 0.76) 0%, rgba(8, 33, 41, 0.54) 52%, rgba(8, 33, 41, 0.62) 100%), url("
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 4 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div#planner.planner → rgba(23, 47, 58, 0.016) 0px 9px 25px 0px | a.article-card → rgba(23, 47, 58, 0.07) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(23, 47, 58, 0.04) 0px 1px 2px 0px,  | a.article-card → rgba(23, 47, 58, 0.07) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(23, 47, 58, 0.04) 0px 1px 2px 0px,
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: 37 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header#site-header.site-header 1440px | section.placements 1440px | section.trust-stats 1440px | button#tab-mba-admissions.service-tab 522px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.
Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.
Remove unless it is a real drop zone.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.3:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.
Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 12 different lines (80px, 676px, 955px, 56px, 111px, 522px, 544px); the three most used hold only 50% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: 1 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Question 1 of 3" above "What’s on your mind?"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.
